learning_rules: Separate directional correctness from price/EV correctness and observed executed P&L. A PASS on a winner is not a losing trade, a PASS on a loser is not a winning trade.
Store prospectively all evaluated candidates including PASS with immutable pre-kickoff timestamp and source. Do not reconstruct quote/model outputs after seeing scores.

Separate quality/depth prior from actual XI availability and tactic/transition vulnerability. Analyze elite-team upset and short-odds downside using pregame xG, lineup and style matchup, not final score hindsight.
Do not tune coefficients to one match or label this a calibrated backtest; aggregate 300-500 genuinely frozen predictions across all fixtures and evaluate Brier/log loss, ROI and CLV.
Maintain explicit incomplete/no-quote/unknown results status and do not modify paper/signals.json, paper/results.json or confirmed real trade ledger from merely theoretical picks.

Live-game example: Bremen 0-2 Augsburg and 3-2 FT belongs in *retrospective hypothesis*; reconstructing a positive-EV hypothetical after the final is prohibited. Require frozen event state, quote age and conditional fair before paper execution.

All scheduled Bundesliga fixtures must appear in the fixture-universe review, even if there was no morning model/market recommendation. Clearly mark NO_DOCUMENTED_CALL instead of scoring them as predictions.

A low-scoring prior form streak must be decomposed into shot quality/volume, opponent class and finishing noise, as exemplified by Hamburg's first league win/goals. Do not fit coefficients to one upset.

Research audit must look across overnight and T-1H assistant messages before classifying NO_DOCUMENTED_CALL; retain versioned odds, fair, stake and signal status as originally said. Do not silently erase winning calls when no actual paper fill exists.
Record hypothetical what-if P&L separately from actually booked paper P&L; show quote verification status, slippage/fees and priced-vs-unpriced leans.
